mentions.name: Cozy Watch
mentions.description: This macOS app brings GitHub notifications straight to the desktop, tracking pull requests, CI results, and mentions in real time so users know when they're needed without checking GitHub or digging through emails. It offers a menu bar for quick access and a clean desktop UI for more detail.
mentions.problem: You have to check GitHub or dig through emails to notice when you're needed on pull requests, CI results, or mentions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building Cozy Watch, a macOS app that brings GitHub notifications straight to your desktop.

It tracks pull requests, CI results, and mentions in real time — so you know when you’re needed without checking GitHub or digging through emails.
